datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Uganda on a monthly basis throughout 2011 (January, April, July, October). The classifications were spatially mapped to administrative units and stored in geographic formats (GeoJSON, KML) with metadata including classification scale, scenario type, and assistance eligibility indicators. This represents post-assessment food insecurity impact data rather than hazard or exposure components.
